text: Screen too dim in sunlight? Make it brighter — it is easier on your eyes.
No bank or officer will ever ask for your OTP. If someone asks, it is a scam.
At home, use your own Wi-Fi instead of mobile data. Videos will not eat your pack.
Seen a bill or message you need later? Take a screenshot to keep it.
Update your apps once a month. Updates fix mistakes and keep you safe.
Phone says storage full? Delete blurry photos and old videos first.
Stuck on a step? Take a screenshot and send it to family on WhatsApp to ask for help.
